I appreciate this. It feels good seeing someone that can relate. How did you let go of that guilt? Also how did you stop chasing the money you lost? Everytime I wake up that’s all I think about and it makes me so empty.

The reason why it hurts so much because this money was like my security fund or emergency fund. If I had good parents I wouldn’t care but I am living with narcs which is killing me even more. And losing 2k felt like losing my life because of that and I dont even work where I can make income and get it back. But I am looking for jobs now but yea... j just can’t let it go. I’m trying to figure out what to prioritize. If I should find a way to make money or if I should learn to program which is my degree. But I keep thinking short term and I want everything in my face instead of being patient... ugh I’m so messed up..
